question: Which of the following war ended with the treaty of Salbai?
solution:
The correct answer is __**First anglo Maratha War.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ​​The **British East India Company **and the **Maratha Empire** engaged in combat during the **First Anglo-Maratha War.**
 
• It** started in 1775 **with the entrance of a** British force under Colonel Robert Clive's leadership** and ended in **1782 with the Treaty of Salbai.**
 
• The Marathas besieged the **British defences at Pune** to start the war.
 
• In response, the British dispatched a sizable army led by** General Francis Hastings **to lift the siege.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Third Battle of Panipat:**

 
 
• The** Maratha Empire and the Durrani Empire's** invasion force engaged in the Third Battle of Panipat on **January 14, 1761.**
 
 
 
• **Battle of Buxar:**
 
 
• The Battle of Buxar took place on **October 22 and 23, 1764.**
 
• It was fought between the **British East India Company,** led by **Hector Munro,** and the combined armies of **Mir Qasim, Nawab of Bengal till 1764; the Nawab of Awadh, Shuja-ud-Daula; and the Mughal Emperor, Shah Alam II.**
 
 
 
• **Second Anglo-Maratha War:**
 
 
• Battle of the Second Anglo-Maratha War took place between (**1803-1805).**
 
• The** Maratha Empire and the British East India Company** were at odds over this issue. 
 
 

ac:T
